title: Proof Of Dev
tagline: A sybil resistant Web3 Builder reputation protocol.Endorse and get recognized for your on-chain work.
description:
Proof of dev is a sybil resistant Web3 Builder reputation protocol. Endorse and get recognized for your on-chain work.
Features:
Seamless user onbaording using Dynamic wallet integration
Sybil resistance using World ID verification for humaness proofs
Endorsement attestations using Sign Protocol
how_its_made:
We have used Worldcoin for Humaness proof verification when onboarding a user on the platform.
Sign protocol is used to attest all the endorsements given by one user to a builder. We have integrated dynamic wallet for easy user onboarding.
Proof of Dev smart contracts handles user registeration after successful humaness proof verification.
